entities.summary: Andrei Vyacheslavovich Loktionov is a Russian professional ice hockey player who is currently playing with Sibir Novosibirsk in the Kontinental Hockey League (KHL). He also played in the National Hockey League (NHL) with the Los Angeles Kings, New Jersey Devils, and the Carolina Hurricanes. Loktionov was drafted by the Kings in the fifth round, 128th overall, at the 2008 NHL Entry Draft
